paragraphs: LetzChat sells real-time translation for websites, mobile apps, and live digital environments. The company frames the product as translation delivery for websites, apps, and live digital experiences with dedicated experts and measurable outcomes. Listed capabilities include multilingual website translation, built-in ROI analytics, enterprise support, and readiness for website and mobile app use.

Integration options cover custom software, web, mobile app, and chat use cases. The site says the product connects with Angular, React Native, JavaScript, and other major frameworks. Security material on the site cites SOC 2 and ISO-certified systems, with GDPR and CCPA compliance.
The industries the site names are automotive, sports, government, and enterprise. One testimonial on the page is attributed to Brad Mugg, Managing Partner at Honda of Downtown Los Angeles.

quote.text: Already deployed across complex enterprise and government environments.
